Summarised from the IRS General Instructions for Forms W-2 and W-3. Where this page and the IRS instructions disagree, the IRS instructions win.

1. Due dates
   • Furnish Copies B, C and 2 to employees and file Copy A with Form W-3 (OMB No. 1545-0008) by February 2, 2026 — January 31, 2026 falls on a Saturday.
   • Extensions (Form 8809) are only granted for specific hardship reasons and are not automatic.

2. Box a — Employee's social security number
   • Enter the number exactly as shown on the employee's social security card (nine digits, XXX-XX-XXXX).
   • If the employee has applied for a card, enter "Applied For" and file a W-2c when the number arrives.
   • Never enter an ITIN in box a. ITINs begin with 9 and are for tax filing only; an employee who shows you an ITIN is not work-authorised on that basis.
   • You may truncate the SSN on employee copies (B, C, 2) to the last four digits, shown as XXX-XX- followed by the four digits, or with asterisks. You may not truncate it on Copy A, and you may never truncate the EIN in box b.

3. Box b — Employer identification number
   • Format 00-0000000. Use the EIN on Forms 941/944 for the same period; if you don't have one yet, enter "Applied For" and apply with Form SS-4.

4. Box d — Control number: optional, for your own records (e.g. 0001-A). Not a TIN.

5. Box 12 codes most often used: C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, Y, Z, AA, BB, DD, EE, FF, GG, HH, II. Enter the code, then the amount, e.g. "D 2,500.00". Do not enter more than four codes per W-2; use a second form if needed.

6. Rates and limits for 2025
   • Social security wage base: $176,100 (6.2% each for employer and employee; max employee tax $10,918.20).
   • Medicare: 1.45% each, no wage base; Additional Medicare Tax 0.9% on wages over $200,000 (employee only).

7. Where to file paper Copy A
   Social Security Administration, Direct Operations Center, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18769-0001.
   Using a private delivery service: add "ATTN: W-2 Process, 1150 E. Mountain Dr." and use ZIP code 18702-7997.

   • SSA employer reporting: 800-772-6270 (TTY 800-325-0778), Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–7 p.m. ET.
   • IRS business and specialty tax line: 800-829-4933.
   • Verify employee names and SSNs before filing with SSNVS (Business Services Online). The IRS TIN Matching program is for Forms 1099, not W-2.

### Fixed
- **TIN parsing.** SSNs and EINs pasted with Unicode dashes (U+2010–U+2015, U+2212 MINUS SIGN), non-breaking hyphens (U+2011), NBSP/NNBSP separators or full-width digits (U+FF10–U+FF19) are normalised before validation. (TAX-4471)
